mapper.insert: insert ignore into mall_stock(sku_id,available_quantity,locked_quantity,sold_quantity,warning_threshold,create_time,update_time) select sku_id,available_stock,0,0,0,now(),now() from mall_sku where del_flag='0'

insert ignore into mall_stock(sku_id,available_quantity,locked_quantity,sold_quantity,warning_threshold,create_time,update_time) select sku_id,available_stock,0,0,0,now(),now() from mall_sku where sku_id=#{skuId} and del_flag='0'
mapper.select: select st.*,s.sku_code,s.sku_name from mall_stock st join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=st.sku_id where st.sku_id=#{skuId} and s.del_flag='0'
select st.*,s.sku_code,s.sku_name from mall_stock st join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=st.sku_id where st.sku_id=#{skuId} and s.del_flag='0' for update

select st.*,s.sku_code,s.sku_name,p.product_name,p.publish_status, case when st.available_quantity<=0 then 'OUT_OF_STOCK' when st.available_quantity<=st.warning_threshold then 'LOW_STOCK' else 'HEALTHY' end stock_status from mall_stock st join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=st.sku_id join mall_spu p on p.spu_id=s.spu_id where s.del_flag='0' and p.del_flag='0' and s.sku_code like concat('%',#{skuCode},'%') and st.sku_id=#{skuId} and p.product_name like concat('%',#{productName},'%') and p.publish_status=#{publishStatus} and st.available_quantity<=0 and st.available_quantity>0 and st.available_quantity<=st.warning_threshold and st.available_quantity>st.warning_threshold order by st.update_time desc,st.sku_id
select l.*,s.sku_code from mall_stock_log l join mall_sku s on s.sku_id=l.sku_id where l.sku_id=#{skuId} and l.operation_type=#{operationType} order by l.log_id desc
select * from mall_stock_reservation where order_no=#{orderNo} and sku_id=#{skuId} for update
select * from mall_stock_reservation where order_no=#{orderNo} order by reservation_id
mapper.update: update mall_stock_reservation set status=#{status},update_time=now() where reservation_id=#{reservationId} and status='LOCKED'
update mall_stock set available_quantity=available_quantity-#{quantity},locked_quantity=locked_quantity+#{quantity},update_time=now() where sku_id=#{skuId} and available_quantity>=#{quantity}
update mall_stock set available_quantity=available_quantity+#{quantity},locked_quantity=locked_quantity-#{quantity},update_time=now() where sku_id=#{skuId} and locked_quantity>=#{quantity}
update mall_stock set locked_quantity=locked_quantity-#{quantity},sold_quantity=sold_quantity+#{quantity},update_time=now() where sku_id=#{skuId} and locked_quantity>=#{quantity}
update mall_sku s join mall_stock st on st.sku_id=s.sku_id set s.available_stock=st.available_quantity,s.update_time=now() where s.sku_id=#{skuId}
